title: AsyncStream production and consumption
summary: Bridge a finite callback-style producer into an asynchronous sequence and finish it explicitly.
triggers: adapt a finite producer to for-await consumption
prompts: Collect a finite stream of editor events in the order they were produced.
invariant: All yielded events are buffered in order and the finished stream eventually ends.
mantra: Yield events; finish production; consume with for await.
pitfalls: Without finish, a finite consumer may wait indefinitely.
This small finite example uses default unbounded buffering; continuous producers need a buffering and cleanup policy.
